points.problem: Exclude hardware text-to-graphics and fullscreen handshake,retain original state getter
points.evidence: Original TextToGraphics invokes foreground focus waits and SetConsoleDisplayMode(CONSOLE_FULLSCREEN_MODE);CheckForFullscreenSwitch disables software updates for FULLSCREEN and manages physical Console handshakes. These are X86GFX hardware responsibilities. Current product deliberately excludes X86GFX but still requires original getNtScreenState from keybd_io.c keyboard initialization (useHostInt10 assignment). Restoring the enclosing original X86GFX extent hides that required symbol;activating it would reintroduce prohibited hardware rendering.
points.minimum: Preserve X86GFX #error and the small original getter outside that exclusion;no emulated hardware handshake.

points.evidence: Original hostModeChange reads guest AL and calls TextToGraphics for graphics modes. Its entire definition is under X86GFX and depends on hardware fullscreen signaling;current software VGA selects its mode through original video implementation and copied frontend. No selected caller to hardware TextToGraphics/hostModeChange exists. Original #error exclusion must remain by owner policy.
points.minimum: Preserve excluded original outer frame and #error;no original hardware revival.

points.problem: Copy console cells into shared planar CHAIN2 backing
points.evidence: copyConsoleToRegen first increments to after character then stores attribute. Current +=7 therefore advances8 bytes per cell;original +=3 advances4. Shared backing is4*(CPU-address&~1)+(CPU-address&1),so cells at CPU addresses0,2,4 begin0,8,16. Existing r0502 source and actual generated-reader controls prove original compact mapping fails12/16 positions across shared planes;prior guest VDD unchained save lost alternating characters. nt_cga and get_chain2_screen_ptr consume this same backing. Reverting only the increment misplaces every cell after the first;reverting whole layout revives cross-mode defect.
points.minimum: One constant replacement is minimal;no new copy buffer/repacking state. Retain pending owner.
